title: Record envelope
description: Domain-neutral wrapper around every record persisted by the record store (OOS-0003, ADR-0009). The body is validated separately against the schema named by its record type. Supersession is recorded on the NEW record; the superseded record is never modified.

id.description: Stable record id; equals body.id; unique per type case-insensitively.

schema_version.description: x-oos-schema-version of the body schema when written.

revision.description: 1 for new records; incremented only for mutable types.

provenance.description: Who wrote this revision and under what authority (MEMORY_MODEL: every entry is attributable).

authority.description: Authority under which it was written, e.g. a D-level or a decision/ADR reference.

evidence.description: References (EVD-, DEC-, ADR-, ...). Never secret material.

source.description: Where the content came from (import, observation, agent output, ...).

supersedes.description: Id of the same-type record this one supersedes.

previous_digest.description: Digest of the prior revision (mutable types): a per-record hash chain.

extensions.description: Reserved for future domain-neutral metadata (e.g. audit fields). Empty in format 1.

digest.description: sha256 of the canonical envelope without this field; detects corruption and out-of-band edits.
